abstract: Quantize Hugging Face LLMs with LLM Compressor (vllm-project/llm-compressor) into compressed-tensors checkpoints for vLLM: oneshot recipes for FP8, INT8, W4A16 (GPTQ, AWQ), NVFP4 and MXFP4, KV cache and MoE models, calibration data, disk offload and DDP for huge models, model-free PTQ, serving and verifying in vLLM, troubleshooting and updating. Verified against llm-compressor 0.14.0 and vLLM v0.31.0.
